Senior Data Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience in fintech.

Requirements:
- Strong experience with Python and SQL
- Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka and Airflow
- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Experience building real-time fraud detection pipelines in fintech

Responsibilities:
- Design and build scalable ETL pipelines
- Collaborate with data science teams on model deployment
- Mentor junior engineers
